senses.gloss: भौवन॑ mfn. (fr. भुवन) belonging to the world, AV.
भौवन॑ m. patr. of Viśva-karman (cf. भौमन), of Sādhana &c., VS.; Br.; BhP.
भौवनायन m. patr. fr. भुवन or भौवन, VS.
भौवादिक mfn. (fr. √ भू + आदि) belonging to that class of roots which begins with √ भू, belonging to the first class, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 75, Sch.
भौवायन॑ m. (fr. 2. भू॑, or भुव) patr. of Kapi-vana, MaitrS.; PañcavBr.
